description: Machine temperature exceeds safe operating limits. This can cause damage to components and pose safety risks.
troubleshootingSteps: Check cooling fan operation - ensure it's running and not blocked
Inspect ventilation system - clear any obstructions
Reduce machine load - allow cooling time
Clean air filters - replace if necessary
Check for blocked vents - ensure proper airflow
Verify ambient temperature is within operating range

description: Motor is drawing excessive current, indicating it's working beyond its rated capacity.
troubleshootingSteps: Check motor load - reduce if excessive
Inspect for mechanical binding - check for obstructions
Verify power supply voltage - ensure it matches motor requirements
Check motor bearings - replace if worn
Reduce operational load - allow motor to cool
Inspect motor windings for damage

description: CNC spindle malfunction detected. The spindle may not be rotating correctly or has lost position.
troubleshootingSteps: Check spindle motor connections - ensure all connections are secure
Inspect spindle bearings - replace if worn or damaged
Verify spindle speed settings - check program parameters
Check for tool holder issues - ensure proper installation
Review CNC program parameters - verify spindle commands
Check spindle encoder for faults

description: Compressed air pressure below required threshold. System cannot maintain adequate pressure.
troubleshootingSteps: Check air filter condition - replace if dirty
Inspect for air leaks - check all connections
Verify compressor oil level - top up if needed
Check pressure regulator settings - adjust if necessary
Inspect air lines for blockages - clear any obstructions
Check compressor intake - ensure adequate airflow

description: Conveyor belt is slipping on drive pulley, causing reduced efficiency and potential damage.
troubleshootingSteps: Check belt tension - adjust if too loose
Inspect belt condition - replace if worn
Verify pulley alignment - correct if misaligned
Check for material buildup - clean pulleys
Inspect drive motor - ensure proper operation
Check belt tracking - adjust if necessary
